title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 5 — WORLD 2: A2+ TO B1 BRIDGE
description: A stronger Grade 5 progression into independent English: longer connected speech, richer grammar, practical reasoning, multi-step comprehension and more natural interaction.

missions.title: Vocabulary Lab — Words in Families
missions.focus: prefixes, suffixes, word families, collocations, common phrasal verbs and context-based vocabulary

missions.title: Present Perfect Power
missions.focus: have/has + past participle for experiences, recent events and unfinished time; ever, never, just, already, yet

missions.title: Past Perfect Starter
missions.focus: understanding earlier and later past events with had + past participle in clear narratives

missions.title: Used To & Life Changes
missions.focus: used to for past habits and states, present contrasts and describing how life has changed

missions.title: Modal Mission — Rules, Advice & Possibility
missions.focus: must, have to, should, could, may, might and can for obligation, advice, permission and possibility

missions.title: Conditionals in Real Life
missions.focus: zero and first conditional for facts, warnings, plans, consequences and everyday decisions

missions.title: Reason & Result
missions.focus: because, so, therefore, although, but, however and other connectors for clearer communication

missions.title: People, Personality & Relationships
missions.focus: personality vocabulary, describing behavior, giving examples and discussing relationships respectfully

missions.title: Media, Technology & Information
missions.focus: news, websites, apps, messages, devices, online behavior and identifying basic information reliably

missions.title: B1 Bridge Conversation Lab
missions.focus: 7-minute conversation with follow-up questions, explanations, comparisons, experiences and opinions

missions.title: Reading Explorer — A Difficult Decision
missions.focus: 700–850 word narrative with gist, detail, sequence, vocabulary in context and simple inference

missions.title: Listening Lab — Four Real Voices
missions.focus: 6–8 minute listening with different speakers, natural speed, key details, attitude and purpose

missions.title: Writing Lab — Opinion Paragraph
missions.focus: 180–220 word opinion text with a clear position, reasons, examples and conclusion

missions.title: Conversation Repair & Clarification
missions.focus: asking someone to repeat, checking meaning, paraphrasing, correcting yourself and keeping communication moving

missions.title: Customer Service Mission
missions.focus: returns, bookings, complaints, requests, explanations, apologies and polite solutions

missions.title: Travel Problem Solver
missions.focus: missed transport, changed plans, hotel issues, directions and explaining a problem clearly

missions.title: Mini Debate — Give Me Your Reasons
missions.focus: agreeing and disagreeing politely, supporting an opinion, asking follow-up questions and responding to another view

missions.title: Story Mission — What Really Happened?
missions.focus: integrating past forms, sequencing, description, dialogue and cause-and-effect in a longer story

missions.title: A2+ to B1 Integrated Marathon
missions.focus: advanced Grade 5 review across vocabulary, grammar, reading, listening, speaking, writing and real-life communication

missions.title: WORLD 2 MASTER QUEST — B1 BRIDGE
missions.focus: multi-stage mastery assessment with reading, listening, problem solving, conversation, opinion, writing and real-life scenarios

content_targets.core_vocabulary: 800+ active words, phrases, collocations and common phrasal verbs
content_targets.listening: 6–8 minute multi-speaker listening with natural everyday speed
content_targets.speaking: 7-minute sustained conversation with follow-up questions and explanations
content_targets.mastery: Learner begins moving from elementary communication toward independent B1-style communication by connecting ideas, explaining reasons, handling problems and sustaining longer interactions.
